description: Planner produces a plan with a Tier line and a Files: header naming concrete paths (headless stdout delivery contract).
prompt:
Create a complete implementation plan for the following task.

Task: Add src/calc/stats.py with mean(values) and median(values) (empty list -> ValueError) plus tests in tests/test_stats.py matching the existing test style.

Before writing anything, explore the codebase with BATCHED parallel Read/Grep/Glob calls.
Return the complete plan document in your final response.

The plan MUST state its Tier and a `Files:` header listing every path it will touch.

checks.why: plan must carry a Files: header naming paths
plan must include a rollback strategy

checks.pattern: (?i)would you like me to|shall i proceed
